nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Hey! It's you. Thank CORA, someone I recognize. Hey I have a question... where the fuck am I?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! It's you. Thank CORA, someone I recognize. Hey I have a question... where the fuck am I?

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Always. But more specifically?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Always. But more specifically?

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Really? Listen, I'm hallucinating a lot right now. I might be imagining things, but it sounded like you said I was in the sewers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Listen, I'm hallucinating a lot right now. I might be imagining things, but it sounded like you said I was in the sewers.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: This is what I get for eating all those expired mushrooms.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is what I get for eating all those expired mushrooms.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I'm having a trip so bad I think I'm in the sewers, so yeah, mushrooms can expire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm having a trip so bad I think I'm in the sewers, so yeah, mushrooms can expire.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Who would come to see me speak in the sewers! No one, that's who.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who would come to see me speak in the sewers! No one, that's who.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Hey hey hey! Come on now. You know how it works. The words find their way into the... fertile soil. They pollinate!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Look, I'll level with you, right now I don't know if we're friends, enemies, or if it's you... mom? I don't even know if you're real. But whoever you are, I'm gonna get my head clear and I'll see you on the next leg of the speaking tour.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: That's real kind of you, potentially-real-person, but I'll be just fine when I get back to the stone cold. I'm drying out fine, but sometimes the wets get deep into your cerebellum and it takes a while, you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's real kind of you, potentially-real-person, but I'll be just fine when I get back to the stone cold. I'm drying out fine, but sometimes the wets get deep into your cerebellum and it takes a while, you know?
